welcome.title: Welcome to LetShare4Gov
welcome.body: This is your facility workspace: tickets, reservations, real estate, maintenance and more in one place. In half a minute we'll show you the essentials.

navigation.title: All modules at a glance
navigation.body: Use the menu on the left to move between modules. What you see depends on your role — a service desk agent gets different tools than a caterer or administrator.

content.title: Your working area
content.body: The content of the selected module appears here: overviews, detail pages and forms. The dashboard shows today's status at a glance.

language.title: Pick your language
language.body: The entire application is available in six languages. Switch at any time using this button.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: Find updates about your tickets, reservations and tasks here, so you never miss a thing.

finish.title: Ready to explore
finish.body: Feel free to click around — as a guest you can view everything without changing anything. You can restart this tour any time from the profile menu in the bottom left.
